candidate: E03 plus replay views plus effective draft-budget scheduler
decision: Owner accepts the measured candidate and its remaining observed performance decreases, including the possibility that they are systematic, in exchange for the recorded gains.

final_table.aggregation: Median of the native per-run values from the three complete follow-up suites, compared with the frozen baseline medians.

presentation.policy: The owner requests that small decreases of roughly 1–2% be shown as approximately unchanged. Exact percentage deltas remain visible; the label is a presentation convention, not a statistical equivalence finding.

limits: Acceptance is an owner decision about the measured tradeoffs; it does not establish that every decrease is noise.
The cause of the initial C1 slowdown remains unisolated; the follow-up changed no serving code or configuration.
The decision does not replace the frozen baseline or establish completed IaC promotion and reproduction.
